title: Quantum effects in biology show decoherence does not remove them all

statements.text: Tunneling, superposition, coherence and entanglement have been found in biological phenomena, so the decoherence effects Tegmark estimated are not enough to remove every quantum effect in biological systems beyond the molecular level.

sources.quote: the decoherence effects observed by Tegmark are not sufficient to eliminate all quantum effects in biological systems beyond the molecular level
